text:
maria_csm: Quick flag — MeridianPay onboarding health dipped to ~62% after last night's tail-latency spike. Renewal in ~6 weeks; customer is asking about predictable latency under burst traffic. Proactive idea: run an int8 quantization pilot + model-swap to a compact variant for burst routing, plus a region-aware fallback. Thoughts?

oliver_ml: Agree this is priority. int8 for the generator routes looks safe based on our evals, but we should limit initial traffic. Propose 5% canary then 25% if no regressions. Also suggest keeping float32 for multi-turn dialogs where quality matters.

kevin_engineer: I can create the canary. Need the exact routing policy and metric checks — p95 latency, token-cost delta, and hallucination eval hits. Will wire up alerting for >10% cost delta or p95 > 450ms.

sam_infra: For routing, prefer a latency-first policy with a cost cap override. Example policy snippet: ```json
{"policy": "latency_first", "fallbacks": ["redwood-compact-v2","redwood-compact-v1"], "cost_cap_usd_per_1k": 2.50, "region_preferences": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"]}```

maria_csm: Nice. Add the quant profile we should test (keep beam=1, top_p=0.95). Also include a KV-prefix caching suggestion for their common prompts to smooth bursts.

oliver_ml: Quant profile (simple): ```json
{"quant": "int8", "calibration_subset": 256, "disable_per_channel": false, "preserve_layernorm_fp32": true}``` We'll run internal eval suite against their top-200 prompt set first.

kevin_engineer: Canary plan outline: 1) deploy quantized checkpoint as canary, 2) route 5% traffic via routing policy, 3) run canary for 48h with automated rollback on regression, 4) capture customer-facing metrics dashboard. I'll create the canary job now.

deploy_bot: Canary created: canary/meridian-int8-1766664321 id: canary-8793. Initial traffic: 5%. Health checks: p95 latency, token-cost-delta, generation-quality-score.

june_csm: I've scheduled a sync w/ MeridianPay for Fri 10:00am PT to walk through the plan and capture feedback. I'll share their top prompt examples and expected SLOs ahead of the call.

maria_csm: Risk note for renewal: if tail latency persists we expect pushback on pricing. This proactive pilot + clear dashboard should reduce risk. Capture any quality notes from the canary and we'll package as a pro-active enablement deck.

oliver_ml: We'll attach an A/B eval report after 48h. If metrics look good, recommend step-up to 25% and enable the compact model as scheduled fallback during peak windows.

kevin_engineer: Logged the rollout task: `#infra-rolling-canary-8793` and added alerts to the Meridian workspace. Will ping when metrics stream is live.

maria_csm: tagging @oliver_ml @kevin_engineer @june_csm — confirm readiness by Thu EOD so we can show the customer progress on Fri.

june_csm: Copy — will get customer examples in by Thu noon.

sam_infra: Quick note — set autoscale min to 2x for the canary window to avoid transient queuing.

maria_csm: Perfect. Thanks all — we'll capture feedback during the call and iterate on the quant/profile if customers report any degradation. :thumbsup:
